fuzzer.name: ProFuzzBench AFLNet
fuzzer.runtime_patch: 每个样本响应收集后向一次性 Kafka JVM 发送 SIGTERM 并等待退出，AFL 将 SIGTERM 识别为正常终止；JVMTI 仅记录 KafkaApis 分派入口以及 ApiVersions、TopicMetadata、Produce、Fetch 处理方法的存在位；Kafka 覆盖仅运行三次快速校准；正式运行每个样本使用 120 秒硬超时，退出留 150 秒收尾；短预检仅用两粒代表性种子和 45 秒样本上限

target_launcher: AFLNet 插桩 ELF 启动器通过 exec 启动 start-kafka.sh，不创建额外进程

coverage.fuzzer_feedback: JVMTI method-presence callbacks for KafkaApis request handlers set AFLNet shared-map bytes
coverage.source_line_and_branch: JaCoCo 0.8.13, collected by clean broker replay
coverage.jacoco_agent_includes: kafka/server/KafkaApis*（仅 Kafka 请求处理类；避免扩大插桩范围）

instrumentation.aflnet: LLVM trace-pc-guard; removes obsolete -mllvm coverage-threshold argument pair
instrumentation.compiler_runtime: libclang-rt-18-dev from the locked Ubuntu snapshot

build.kafka_build_method: verified-official-release-binary; source archive used for JaCoCo source mapping
build.gradle_compile: not run in this constrained VM

resource_limits.build_strategy: Use SHA-512 pinned Apache 4.4.0 binary; do not compile Kafka with Gradle in this constrained VM.

distribution.verification: Apache official SHA-512 sidecars, pinned in this lock; the source archive supplies JaCoCo source mapping. The tested Kafka broker comes from the matching 4.4.0 official binary archive.
